methodology.title: Methodology, Provenance & Scientific Disclosure
methodology.subtitle: Complete transparency on modeling architecture, spatial evaluation holdouts, data provenance, and operational boundaries.
methodology.pipeline_desc: End-to-end flow from regional numerical forecasts to panchayat-specific agricultural recommendations.
methodology.step_1_desc: Coarse regional numerical forecast (10-25 km grid NWP/IMD models).
methodology.step_2_desc: High-resolution DEM elevation, slope, aspect, and land cover.
methodology.step_3_desc: Two-stage hurdle classifier and quantile LightGBM models.
methodology.step_4_desc: Panchayat-level downscaled rain, max/min temp with P10/P50/P90.
methodology.step_5_desc: Spatial conformal calibration provides 80% coverage intervals.
methodology.step_6_desc: Phenological stage-aware rules emit actionable farming advisories.
methodology.arch_body: KrishiMitra bridges coarse numerical weather forecasts (10–25 km) down to panchayat agro-climatic terrain features using gradient boosted quantile decision trees and two-stage hurdle classification.
methodology.hurdle_body:
Rainfall is zero-inflated with extreme positive skewness. KrishiMitra implements a decoupled two-stage Hurdle formulation:
• Stage 1 (Occurrence): P(Rain ≥ 1.0mm) = Isotonic(LightGBM_Classifier(X))
• Stage 2 (Amount if Wet): Q_τ(Rain | Rain ≥ 1.0mm) = LightGBM_Quantile_τ(X_wet), τ ∈ {0.1, 0.5, 0.9}
• Expectation: E[Rain] = P(Rain) × Q_0.5(Rain | Rain ≥ 1.0mm)
methodology.holdout_body: Standard random train/test splitting causes severe spatial data leakage in geospatial machine learning. KrishiMitra enforces strict spatial cluster holdouts: 23 panchayats in Tumakuru (and corresponding test clusters in each region) are strictly withheld from training and tuning.
methodology.quantile_body: Quantile loss functions penalize over/under-predictions asymmetrically. An independent 20% spatial calibration split calibrates prediction interval widths ensuring valid 80% coverage.
methodology.provenance_body: District boundaries from official sources; sub-district panchayats are illustrative. DEM elevation and terrain features are calibrated with climatology norms.
methodology.disclosure_synthetic: Synthetic-World Skill Caveat: Metrics reported reflect performance against a physics-calibrated synthetic simulator. Real-world skill requires ground-truth AWS/ARG observation telemetry ingestion.
methodology.disclosure_resolution: Resolution Integrity: KrishiMitra operates at the panchayat administrative level. We do not claim 1 km pixel or farm plot-level resolution.
methodology.disclosure_advisory: Institutional Advisory Validation: Rule triggers are built on agronomic literature and IMD agromet guidelines, requiring local KVK agronomist validation before live deployment.
